large-title.purpose: System navigation title; Dynamic Type supplies metrics.

headline.purpose: Package names, progress titles, status labels and primary actions use .headline.

subheadline.purpose: Versions and byte counts use .subheadline; byte counts add .monospacedDigit().

body.purpose: Form text and controls inherit system defaults.

components.name: Source action
components.description: SwiftUI excerpt from InstallerView.swift; displayed as native source.
components.html:
Button {
    choosingFile = true
} label: {
    Label("Choose IPA", systemImage: "folder")
}

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Install or Update confirmation; the same native treatment is used for Open.
components.html:
Button {
    model.install()
} label: {
    Text(model.package?.isUpdate == true ? "Update App" : "Install App")
        .foregroundStyle(Color(uiColor: .systemBackground))
}
.font(.headline)
.frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 44)
.buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)

components.name: Download link
components.description: Native URL field with system keyboard and submission behavior.

components.name: Navigation workspace
components.description: Native Form modifiers inside NavigationStack; excerpt from InstallerView.swift.

components.name: Package summary
components.description: Native package name and version stack; the artwork uses @ScaledMetric with a 64 pt base.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Indeterminate native progress row; download progress is determinate when size is known.
components.html:
HStack(spacing: 12) {
    ProgressView()
    Text(title).font(.headline)
}
.padding(.vertical, 8)
if model.phase.canCancel {
    Button("Cancel", role: .cancel) { model.cancel() }
}

components.name: Technical details
components.description: Native disclosure keeps selectable diagnostics below the failure message.

narrative.overview: System navigation and grouped forms keep package identity, actions and installation state in one workspace.
